meaning.long_meaning: Ayushi corresponds to the Sanskrit form आयुषी. Its core lexical sense is life, longevity, age. आयुषी (āyuṣī) is a feminine formation on आयुस्, life. The source gloss 'Life, Vitality, Auspicious' is close.
